name: Is it better to convert an existing garage or build a brand-new bonus room addition?
description: Garage conversions are faster and save on structural building costs, but newly framed additions preserve your covered vehicle parking and storage space.

mainEntity.name: Is it better to convert an existing garage or build a brand-new bonus room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an attached garage is typically faster and more budget-friendly, while building a new detached or bump-out addition preserves enclosed parking and storage. Garage conversions take advantage of an existing roof, foundation, and exterior walls, primarily requiring slab leveling, wall insulation, drywall, and HVAC additions. However, you give up vehicle protection, which can affect neighborhood aesthetic guidelines or your storage capacity. A newly framed room addition allows you to customize ceiling heights, natural lighting, and architectural transitions while keeping your garage fully functional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions are faster and save on structural building costs, but newly framed additions preserve your covered vehicle parking and storage space.
